paite: Huchi in David bel huai a apawtkhia ay pan Adullam kokhuk ah a-omta hi. Asanggamte leh apate inkote tengteng in azak un huai ah akiang ah ahohsuk uh.
heading: Siampute Thahna
english: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.

paite: Lungkham peuhmah, leiba nei peuhmah leh lungkim lou peuhmahte akiang ah akikaikhawm uh. Huchi in aheutu un a-omta hi. Akiang ah mi zali hiamtak a-om uhi.
english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

paite: David bel huai a pan Moab gam a Mizpah ah ahoh hi. Moab kumpipa kiang ah, "Pathian in ahon hihsak ding thil ka theih masiah ka nu leh ka pate na kiang ah na om le uh," achi hi.
english: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”

paite: Moab kumpipa ma ah amaute api a; huchi in kokhuk a David a-om lai teng akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

paite: Zawlnei Gad in David kiang ah, "Kokhuk ah om nilouh ke'n. Pawt inla Judah gam ah pai in," achi hi. Huchi in David apawt a, Hareth gammang ah alutta hi.
english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

paite: Saul in, "David leh akiang a omte amuta uh," chih ana za hi. Saul bel Gibeah a Ramah a tamarisk sing nuai ah teipi tawi in atu hi. Akim ah asikha tengteng adingh uhi.
english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

paite: Saul in akim a dingh asikhate kiang ah, "Nou Benjamin mite aw, ngaikhia un; Jesse tapa in loute leh grephuante hon pia in asepaih sangkhat heutu leh asepaih zakhat heutu in ahon bawl dia hia?
english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

paite: Na vek un na hon sawm ua, ka tapa in Jesse tapa kiang a thu akhun ka kiang a hihlang himhim na om kei uh. Ka tapa in ka sikha kei hon dou ding leh tuni nangawn a kei hon tang dia ahanthawn thu ka kiang a hihlang na om louh uh?" achi hi.
english: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

paite: Huchi in Saul sikhate kiang a ding Edom mi Doeg in adawng a, "Jesse tapa Nob a Ahitub tapa Ahimelek kiang a, ahong lam ka mu hi.
english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA adotsak a, nek ding apia a, Philistia mi Goliath namsau leng ape lai hi," achi hi.
english: He inquired of Yahweh for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Ahitub tapa Ahimelek leh Nod a siampu a pang apa inkote tengteng asamsak hi.
english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

paite: Saul in, "Nang, Ahitub tapa, na ngaikhia in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”

paite: Saul in akiang ah, "Tanghou leh namsau na pia a, TOUPA bang dotsak a, tuni a kei hon dou ding leh hon tang dia bang ding a nang leh Jesse tapa in hon guksawm na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

paite: Ahimelek in kumpipa adawng a, "Kumpipa makpa, na thumang, na inkuan sung ua mizahtakhuai David bang a muanhuai na sikhate tengteng lak ah kua a-om ua?
english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?

paite: Amah a dia Pathian thu ka dotsak amasapen ahi a hia? Ahi kei. Kumpipa'n asikha hiam, ka pa inkote kuapeuh hon ngoh mahmah kei hen. Na sikha in hiai thu bangmah ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
english: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Ahimelek, na sih ngeingei ding ahi, nang leh na pa inkote tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang a dingh sepaihte kiang ah, "Kihei unla, TOUPA siampute that un, David lam a apan ua, taimang ahi chih thei napi a ka kiang a agen louh ziak un," achi hi. Himahleh kumpipa sikhate'n TOUPA siampute sual ding in khut azak nuam kei uhi.
english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of Yahweh, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa'n Doeg kiang ah, "Nang kihei inla, siampute sual in,” achi hi. Edom mi Doeg akihei a, siampute asual a, huai ni in puanmalngat siampu puanak silh, mi sawmgiat-le-nga athat hi.
english: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

paite: Nob, siampu khua namsau in asual a; numei leh pasal naupang leh nawi ne laite nangawn, bawngte, sabiltungte leh belamte toh namsau in asatlum hi.
english: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Ahitub tapa Ahimelek tapate lak a khat, amin Abiathar ataikhia a, David kiang ah ataitung hi.
english: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

paite: Abiathar in Saul in TOUPA siampute athah thu David ahilh hi.
english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.

paite: David in Abiathar kiang ah, "Edom mi Doeg huai a, a-om ni mah in Saul ahilh ngeingei ding chih theisa in ka om hi. Na pa inkuan tengteng kei ziak a si ahi uh.
english: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

paite: Nang ka kiang ah om inla, lau ke'n. Kei thah hon tumte'n nang leng thah ahon tum ding uh. Ka kiang ah om lechin na bit ding hi," achi hi.
english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”
